caption: The drawing shows a single red drinking glass centered on an off-white or beige background. The glass has a cylindrical shape with slightly flared sides and vertical faceted sections. The rim at the top is circular and slightly wider than the body, while the bottom of the glass features a clear, round, scalloped base with visible facets suggesting the reflective nature of glass. The red color is prominent throughout the main body of the glass, with varying shades indicating light and shadow. A fine black outline defines the contours and edges of the glass, and there is no liquid inside. The composition is simple and contained within a thin, hand-drawn rectangular border, with the name "JANET RIZA" written in small, capital letters in the bottom-right corner of the drawing.
title: Tumbler
